title: Trend Persistence Engine v0
hypothesis: Observable trend structure at time t contains out-of-sample information about whether directional movement will persist over a future horizon.

target_definition.trend_direction: sign of trailing fast return at time t
target_definition.continuation: future return over the selected horizon has the same sign as the trend direction and exceeds the configured volatility-aware magnitude floor
target_definition.failure: future return reverses against the trend direction and exceeds the same magnitude floor
target_definition.neutral: neither continuation nor failure threshold is reached

promotion_policy.candidate: survives discovery, sample-size audit, and nearby-threshold robustness
promotion_policy.champion: also demonstrates stable portfolio value under predefined exposure policies
promotion_policy.production: requires a separate runtime design and explicit approval
